name: Gopal Kholade
headline: Data Analyst & Applied ML Engineer
bio: Hi, I'm Gopal. I engineer reliable data pipelines, automated ETL workflows, and applied machine learning systems at On Direct Marketing Services in Pune. Day to day, I wrangle complex multi-source datasets with Python, SQL, and PySpark to build clean, validated data products. In my spare time, I experiment with parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT/LoRA), local LLM quantization, and retrieval-augmented systems.
